audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for women at tomb, rolled stone, young man in white, empty tomb, Galilee message, fear/silence at 16:8, and shorter/longer ending as later textual additions rather than main restored text.

verses.restored: When the Sabbath had passed, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go and anoint him.

familiar.text: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

verses.restored: Very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb after the sun had risen.

familiar.text: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

verses.restored: They were saying to one another, Who will roll away the stone for us from the door of the tomb?

familiar.text: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

verses.restored: Looking up, they see that the stone has been rolled away, for it was very large.

familiar.text: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

verses.restored: Entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a white robe, and they were alarmed.

familiar.text: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

verses.restored: He says to them, Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus the Nazarene, the crucified one. He was raised; he is not here. Look, the place where they laid him.

familiar.text: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

verses.restored: But go, tell his disciples and Peter that he goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.

familiar.text: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

verses.restored: Going out, they fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment held them; and they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.

familiar.text: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

textual_notes.note: Many later manuscripts include a longer ending after 16:8. This project keeps 16:8 as the restored primary ending while preserving the longer ending as a textual tradition note rather than erasing it.
Some witnesses include a shorter ending after 16:8. It is noted as a later textual ending, not the main restored reading.
